protocol.primary_menu: Different-trip departures within +/-300 seconds of scheduled incoming arrival plus GTFS station transfer; fixed by the timetable before actual outcomes.
protocol.secondary_menu: The same +/-300-second window centered on traveler-ready time after the observed incoming arrival.
protocol.information: Only the rider-known incoming arrival and RT receipts at or before that clock. All methods receive the same information; the conditional candidates use the observed arrival, while the frozen original mixture remains unchanged.
protocol.source: Existing official national SBB daily archive, remotely range-read at most 1 MiB per date and filtered to the fixed 16 station cohort. Only small compressed event subsets and audit receipts are copied locally.
protocol.missingness: Every scheduled action remains a candidate. Unknown outgoing outcomes remain eligible during action selection; scoring censors them afterward. Clock intervals condition on observed operating REAL departures; explicit cancellation contributes to binary boarding scores.
protocol.decision_rule: Evaluate every frozen model and both frozen menu-specific interval offsets. No fitting, weight selection, scale changes, interval widening or further date search follows the confirmation readout.
protocol.statistical_unit: Date. Pairs share arrivals, trips and outcomes and are not treated as independent replications.
protocol.scope: Local incoming-known transfer prediction. Marginal or local-pair laws do not replace the coherent joint trip belief or establish journey-policy value improvement.

scope: Independent predeclared dates; all fits, parameters and menu-specific interval offsets were frozen before inspecting these actual outcomes. No further date or parameter selection.
